after_page.title: GitHub - tinyhumansai/openhuman: Your Personal AI super intelligence. Private, Simple and extremely powerful. · GitHub

ai_execution.code:
async def run(page, results):
    import re
    # 修复策略：使用 filter(has_text=re.compile(r'\d')) 筛选出包含数字的 /stargazers 链接，
    # 从而排除仅有图标的链接，解决 strict mode violation 错误。
    star_locator = page.locator('a[href*="/stargazers"]').filter(has_text=re.compile(r'\d'))
    
    count = "未找到"
    if await star_locator.count() > 0:
        count = await star_locator.inner_text()
    else:
        # 备选方案：根据错误日志中看到的 role name ('18.3k stars') 进行匹配
        star_link_role = page.get_by_role('link', name=re.compile(r'[\d\.,]+[km]?\s*stars?', re.IGNORECASE))
        if await star_link_role.count() > 0:
            count = await star_link_role.inner_text()
    
    return {"star_count": count.strip() if count else "未找到"}
